title: Glucose restriction induced by intermittent fasting promotes alternative metabolic fluxes leading to memory CD8T cell development.
snippet: Dietary restrictions are increasingly recognized as modulators of immune cell function. However, how they shape CD8T cell fate decisions remains incompletely understood. Here, we investigated the impact of intermittent fasting (IF) on differentiation of heterogeneous effector T cell subsets and the formation of a long-lived homeostatic memory pool. We found...
